title: 86: README + usage docs + worked examples
description:
GitHub: #86 (https://github.com/prajoria/OpenBB/issues/86)
Phase: P8 · Sprint 7 · Size M
Design: docs/designs/quant_trading/86-readme-usage-examples.md (review pass approved Q-A..Q-E)

User-facing documentation for the techtrade extension.

## Scope (from issue)
- README.md: install (incl. submodule + extras), command surface, examples
- Worked example: scan -> plan -> export to Excel
- Document presets, weights, risk inputs, disclaimer
- Link back to the PRD spec

## Acceptance criteria (from issue)
- A new user can install + run scan/export from the README alone
- Examples are copy-pasteable and run against fmp_cached

## Design decisions approved (Q-A..Q-E in design doc)
- A3: runnable examples/*.py + offline smoke test (NOT review-only README, NOT linked-fixture)
- B1: Roadmap section for tune (#83) / narrator (#84) / MCP (#85) / streaming (#87), prose not call syntax, bottom of page
- C1: Upfront install matrix mirroring [tool.poetry.extras] + per-example nudges with identical pip strings
- D1: Keep contributor content in README, demoted under `## For Contributors` heading, revisit split at ~200 lines
- E1: No separate docs/quickstart.md for v1; examples/README.md is the index

Depends on (issue): #81 (Excel export - the worked example writes a workbook).

title: 82: backtest_bridge + validate + attach ValidationReport
description:
GitHub: #82 (https://github.com/prajoria/OpenBB/issues/82)
Phase: P6 · Sprint 6 · Size M
Design: docs/designs/quant_trading/82-backtest-bridge-validate.md (approved, commit 6aab703e1)

Bridge to openbb-backtest for robustness validation; expose `validate`.

## Scope (from issue)
- validation/backtest_bridge.py hands rules/plan to openbb-backtest.validate()
- validate(plan, method="wfo"|"cpcv") -> ValidationReport; attach verdict to TradePlan.validation
- Graceful degradation if backtest package absent (clear error, core still works)
- Integration test returns a verdict on a sample plan

## Locked decisions (design §0)
- L1: openbb-backtest is in-tree, imported as installed package (Q1 RESOLVED)
- L2: TradePlan.validation is Data|None (already in models.py)
- L3: Verdict vocabulary = Literal["robust","fragile","overfit"]
- L4: techtrade generates, backtest validates - neither re-implements the other
- L5: Verdict gate lives inside openbb_backtest.validation.build_validation_report
- Q-A: Soft/optional dep + [validation] extra + TechtradeDependencyError(OpenBBError) leaf error
- Q-B: B2 - register a faithful `techtrade_confluence` SignalStrategy via openbb_backtest_strategies entry-point group
- Q-C: Forward method 1:1; backtest's default thresholds; expose optional pass-through
- Q-D: Return OBBject[ValidationReport]; attach via plan.model_copy(update={"validation": report})
- Q-E: Tuning gate is #83's scope, NOT #82
- Q-F: ALL openbb_backtest imports are lazy and in-body; enforced by #85 test

Depends on (issue): #78 (paper broker - a TradePlan to validate), #64 (Q1, RESOLVED).

title: infra: pytest collection collision "No module named 'tests.unit'" when scanning openbb_platform tree
description:
Discovered during #82 verification (2026-06-21).

## Repro
\`\`\`
.venv_win\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest openbb_platform/extensions/techtrade -m "not integration"
\`\`\`
=> "Interrupted: 38 errors during collection" — 1380 tests would collect, but every
test_X.py in techtrade/tests/{unit,integration} fails to import with:

  ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tests.unit'

## Cause (likely)
Both \`openbb_platform/extensions/techtrade/tests/\` and
\`openbb_platform/extensions/backtest/tests/\` (and possibly others) contain
\`__init__.py\` files. pytest's rootdir-based module naming generates
\`tests.unit.test_X\` for both trees — they collide on import.

## Evidence it's pre-existing, not #82
- Running \`pytest openbb_platform/extensions/techtrade/tests/unit/test_backtest_bridge.py\`
  in isolation: 14/14 pass in 2.21s. The file itself imports cleanly.
- Running \`pytest openbb_platform/extensions/techtrade/tests/unit/test_models.py\` (touched
  by #66, well before #82) in isolation: 4 tests collect cleanly.
- The error appears only when pytest is asked to scan the broader tree.

## Likely fix (out of #82 scope; needs its own design call)
Modern pytest convention is no \`__init__.py\` in test dirs (rootdir-based "test packages"
become importable via \`importlib\` mode). Options:
1. Delete \`__init__.py\` from \`tests/\`, \`tests/unit/\`, \`tests/integration/\` across
   all extensions; switch to \`--import-mode=importlib\` in pytest.ini.
2. Add a per-extension \`conftest.py\` that sets \`rootdir\` or uses unique \`tests_<ext>/\` names.
3. Configure pytest's \`pythonpath\` / \`norecursedirs\` to scope collection per extension.

## Acceptance
- \`pytest openbb_platform/extensions/techtrade -m "not integration"\` completes with no
  collection errors.
- All 1380 tests are collected and run.
- No regression to any individually-passing test file.

## Discovered during
\`OpenBBTechnical-7lw\` (82: backtest_bridge + validate + attach ValidationReport) — verification phase.

title: 83: tuneta adapter + tune command, gated by validation
description:
GitHub: #83 (https://github.com/prajoria/OpenBB/issues/83)
Phase: P7 · Sprint 6 · Size M
Spec: docs/Specs/TechnicalTrading-Engine-PRD.md §18 (P7), §19; §12.4 (Optional tuning)

Optional `tuneta` per-segment indicator tuning (Poetry extra), gated by validation.

## Scope (from issue)
- tuning/tuneta_adapter.py behind the [tuneta] extra
- tune(segment, ...) -> TuningReport of proposed params
- Gate: only params passing PRD §15 validation (PBO/DSR via #82's bridge) persist; defaults ship un-tuned
- Test: tuning proposes params; non-robust ones are rejected

## Acceptance criteria (from issue)
- obb.techtrade.tune(...) runs only when extra installed; otherwise clear message
- Tuned params persist only if they pass validation
- Core behavior unchanged when extra absent

Blocked by bd: 82 (depends on validate(...) returning a ValidationReport).
